name: Meng Feng Da
source:
A suspicious thug who roams Kabukicho, committing fraud, fencing stolen goods, and cleverly navigating the lines between every faction from the yakuza to the Chinese gangs to the police.

He's also corrupt cop Sayuki Ugai's pet informant. 

[From Shiravune, via [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1433]MangaGamer[/url]]
